_doc: NEGATIVE CONTROL — DELIBERATELY WRONG. Claims the 2023 figure (£322,000) for a 1 June 2022 death, when SI 2023/758 was not yet in force and the correct as-at figure is £270,000. scripts/test-l6-temporal-oracle.sh runs scripts/oracle_verify.py on this file and PASSES only if the harness exits 1 (RED). If this file ever goes green, the as-at binding has no teeth. It lives outside tests/oracles/*.oracle.json so the default glob never picks it up as a real oracle.
statute: Administration of Estates Act 1925 s.46(1)(i) Table Case (2)(B) and Schedule 1A; SI 2020/33 (Fixed Net Sum Order 2020); SI 2023/758 (Fixed Net Sum Order 2023)

cases.label: wrong-as-at-death-2022-06-01-claims-2023-figure
cases.citation: WRONG ON PURPOSE: £322,000 applies only from 26 July 2023 (SI 2023/758).
